variables.name: Const - GA4 Measurement ID
variables.notes: GA4 property « Dilytics.ch » (330693779, stream « Mon site web »): the one the old site's data goes to (through its server container), in CHF and Zurich time. Not « dilytics.ch - GA4 » (371110963, G-LD77B0HR8Z), which has received nothing since January 2025.

variables.name: Const - LinkedIn Partner ID
variables.notes: The old site's LinkedIn Insight Tag partner ID.

variables.name: CJS - Send mode
variables.notes: prod on dilytics.ch; preview in GTM preview mode; off anywhere else (the staging outside preview). GA4 sends in prod and preview; Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn in prod only (blocking triggers).

variables.name: GTES - Page context
variables.notes: Shared GA4 event parameters, on every event (page_view included): the page type; the service (the page's, or elsewhere the last one seen in the visit); the visit so far (entry page, pages viewed, services viewed). Pushed in the head before GTM (includes/assets.php).

variables.name: CJS - Content group
variables.notes: GA4 content group: services by category, the other pages by type.

variables.name: DLV - user_data
variables.notes: {email, phone_number (E.164)} pushed with generate_lead: Google Ads enhanced conversions and Meta advanced matching only, never sent to GA4.

variables.name: UPD - user_data
variables.notes: User-provided data, Code mode: the dataLayer's user_data object ({email, phone_number}), hashed by the Google tag, under ad_user_data consent.

variables.name: CJS - GAds label - click_booking
variables.notes: Existing Ads actions: « Clic | Prendre rendez-vous - Bouton Header » (header), « Clic | Réserver mon entretien - Home Page » (home), « Clic | Réserver mon entretien - Microsoft Bookings » (elsewhere).

variables.name: CJS - GAds label - click_phone
variables.notes: Existing Ads actions: « Clic | N° de Téléphone Barre Supérieure » (header), « Clic | N° de Téléphone - Footer » (elsewhere).

variables.name: CJS - GAds label - click_email
variables.notes: Existing Ads actions: « Clic | Mailto - Barre Supérieure » (header), « Clic | Mailto - Footer bas » (elsewhere).

variables.name: LT - GAds label - page_view
variables.notes: Existing secondary Ads actions « Page Vue | … », one per page; empty elsewhere (no conversion).

variables.name: LT - GAds label - click_contact
variables.notes: Existing Ads actions « Clic | Nous contacter - Page … » and « Clic | Prendre contact - Home Page »; empty elsewhere (no conversion).

variables.name: LT - GAds label - click_social
variables.notes: Existing Ads actions « Clic | Linkedin footer », « Clic | Instagram - Footer », « Clic | Facebook - Footer ».

variables.name: CJS - Meta properties - ecommerce
variables.notes: Meta object properties from the GA4 ecommerce object (view_item, begin_checkout, purchase): content_ids, contents, content_type, content_name, content_category, num_items, value, currency.

variables.name: CJS - Meta ph - user_data.phone_number
variables.notes: Meta advanced matching wants the phone as digits only, country code included.

variables.name: CVT - Unique Event ID
variables.notes: Official stape-io template: one id per dataLayer event, the same in every tag of that event. Sent as event_id to GA4 and as eventID to Meta: a browser event and its future server copy (Conversions API through the server container) deduplicate on it.

triggers.name: CE - click_booking - microsoft_bookings
triggers.notes: A click to Microsoft Bookings: the booking happens there, unseen, so the click stands for it (Meta Schedule). Calendly bookings come as book_appointment.

triggers.name: CE - dl_consent - marketing granted
triggers.notes: dl_consent is pushed by the site right after each Consent Mode update (Complianz choice, and on each page when consent exists). For non-Google tags (Meta, LinkedIn); they fire once per page.

triggers.name: Block - Send mode not prod
triggers.notes: Exception for Google Ads, Meta and LinkedIn: nothing leaves outside dilytics.ch.

triggers.name: Block - Send mode off
triggers.notes: Exception for GA4: nothing leaves from the staging outside GTM preview.

tags.name: Google Tag - GA4 - G-436C2QWD5K
tags.notes: GA4 page_view included, property « Dilytics.ch » (330693779). Consent Mode v2 from the site's head script (denied until Complianz consent): cookieless pings until then.

tags.name: Google Tag - Google Ads - AW-10930930121
tags.notes: Google tag for Ads on every page of dilytics.ch: remarketing audiences, and the gclid kept (so no separate conversion linker, per Google).

tags.name: GAds - Conversion - generate_lead
tags.notes: Existing action « Formulaires_envoyés | Tout le Site Web ». Transaction ID = lead_id (random, one per message). Enhanced conversions: UPD - user_data.

tags.name: GAds - Conversion - click_booking
tags.notes: Label per location: CJS - GAds label - click_booking.

tags.name: GAds - Conversion - click_phone
tags.notes: Label per location: CJS - GAds label - click_phone.

tags.name: GAds - Conversion - click_email
tags.notes: Label per location: CJS - GAds label - click_email.

tags.name: GAds - Conversion - click_contact
tags.notes: Label per page: LT - GAds label - click_contact.

tags.name: GAds - Conversion - click_social
tags.notes: Label per network: LT - GAds label - click_social.

tags.name: GAds - Conversion - page_view
tags.notes: Secondary actions « Page Vue | … » (interest signal, not bidding). Label per page: LT - GAds label - page_view.

tags.name: Meta - Base - PageView
tags.notes: Official Meta Pixel template. After marketing consent only, once per page. Automatic configuration off (no automatic clicks: one event source). Meta-enabled Conversions API opt-in left off: Meta terms for Dilytics to accept themselves.

tags.name: Meta - Event - Lead
tags.notes: Lead (« Prospect ») on each message sent. Advanced matching: e-mail and phone, hashed by the pixel.

tags.name: Meta - Event - Contact
tags.notes: Contact: a tel: or mailto: link clicked.

tags.name: Meta - Event - Schedule
tags.notes: Schedule: an appointment booked in Calendly, or a click to Microsoft Bookings (where the booking itself can't be seen).

tags.name: Meta - Event - InitiateCheckout
tags.notes: InitiateCheckout: a « Payer en ligne » button.

tags.name: Meta - Event - Purchase
tags.notes: Purchase on Stripe's return (value before VAT, CHF).

tags.name: LinkedIn - Base - Insight Tag
tags.notes: Official LinkedIn template. After marketing consent only, once per page. Conversions: add a tag per LinkedIn conversion ID (Campaign Manager) with its Conversion ID.
